Hi, I'm Sum Yee Chong. I'm studying a Master of Business Analytics at Monash University, where I'm learning how to analyse data and explain the results to people who are not data specialists.  

I'm especially interested in how data can be used to make complex topics easier to understand. I also enjoy thinking about how the way information is presented can change what people notice first.  

This site is where I share short data stories that turn research findings into something easier to read.
